description: Suggests a place for the group to vote on (Where). By default it searches Google Places and returns up to five candidates without saving (status needs_selection); calling it again with the chosen google_place_id saves the place with its official details, map link and photo. source=manual saves a supplied name, address or link without a lookup. Duplicates are merged. Use when the user proposes a venue or destination.

google_maps_url.description: Optional Google Maps link (google.com/maps or maps.app.goo.gl). Links with coordinates (…/@50.08,14.42,…) also show a map preview.

google_place_id.description: Exact place ID from returned Google candidates; official details are loaded server-side (max 160 chars).

link.description: Optional link to any other page about the place (http/https), instead of google_maps_url.

name.description: Requested place name, including accents (max 300 chars). A selected Google result supplies its official name.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character plan ID. Links without a plan ID (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/when) are unsaved local drafts and are not accepted.

query.description: Optional Google autocomplete query including the known city/address (max 160 chars); otherwise name/address are used.

source.description: Default auto uses Google first. Manual explicitly saves the supplied name/address/link without a paid lookup.

name: add_place
title: Suggest a place
